specifier.description:

exports.description:
Extra package exports of a public domain, each subpath under the domain's specifier mapped to its file, relative to the domain's directory.
@default none

purpose.description:
One line stating the domain's concern.
@default none

debt.description:
Why the member does not fit the project's Compass, such as the earlier decision it stands on: agents decouple it at each opportunity and never take it as precedent.
@default none

reexport.description:
How the environment's generated root entry re-exports the domain's entry: as a `namespace` named after its package subpath, `flat`, its names spread among the root's, or both as a list. Unset, `namespace`.
@default none

collects.description:
Roles whose collected modules, from every domain of the environment, the domain's generated entry re-exports besides its own modules. Each must be a public collected role of the environment.
@default none

publicRoles.description:
Roles whose modules, in this domain and its sub-domains only, other domains and workspaces import one by one, as they do a public role's. Each must be a role of the environment.
@default none

public.description:
Whether the domain is a package entry, so `engrenage sync` creates the `entry.ts` of a domain without `index.ts`. Unset, whether its `entry.ts` exists; `false` fails when it does.
@default none
